reason: The item is natural granite worked stone (polished slab), which under heading 6802 is classified in subheading 6802.23.00.00 – Granite.
The product is natural, worked stone with a polished surface, which falls under heading 6802 (worked monumental or building stone) rather than artificial stone (6810) or ceramic (6914).

The product is a sulfonamide (contains the –SO2NH– group) and is a pure chemical, so under GRI 1 it falls under Chapter 29 heading 2935 (Sulfonamides) and, not being elsewhere specified, into subheading 2935.90.90 (Other sulfonamides).
The product is an insulated cable with connectors, so under heading 8544.42 (fitted with connectors) and not covered by a more specific subheading, it falls under 8544.42.90.90 – ‘Other’.

The cables are insulated conductors with a connector on one end, thus fall under heading 8544.42 (fitted with connectors) and, per past rulings for similar aviation headset cables, are classified as 8544.42.90.90.
The ensemble is a costume, a festive entertainment article, which CBP rulings (e.g., N329862, N354662) classify under 9505.90.60.00 rather than as a magic trick accessory.

The garment is a woven (not knitted) women's blouse made of a man‑made loose‑weave fabric, so it falls under Chapter 62 heading 6206 and, as a man‑made fiber article subject to fiber restraints, the specific subheading is 6206.90.00.30.
The polished steel balls are individual components, not assembled bearings, thus are not classified under 8482.10 (ball bearings) but as other articles of iron or steel per 7326.90.86.88.

The products are vitamin/mineral/amino‑acid feed supplements for poultry, i.e., preparations used in animal feeding, and are not covered by a more specific subheading such as B12, thus fall under 2309.90.95.00 – Other preparations of a kind used in animal feeding.
The product is an electronic light‑emitting device, not a cosmetic preparation, so it is classified as an apparatus under Chapter 90 (9019) rather than under the cosmetic heading 3307.

The item is a non‑mechanical, foldable hand‑fan made of textile (cotton) and wood, used by waving to create airflow, which CBP has consistently classified under 6307.90.98.91 as a made‑up textile article.
The product is a bulk pharmaceutical active ingredient, not in measured doses or retail packaging, and is a nitrogen‑only heterocyclic compound, thus classified under heading 2933.39.41.00.

The unit combines an AM/FM radio receiver with sound reproducing capability (USB/Bluetooth playback), thus falls under heading 8527.21 (combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus) and the most specific subheading is 8527.21.40.80.

The item is a non‑functional Halloween decorative article, not a toy or magic trick, and absent evidence it is made of base metal it falls under heading 9505 (festive, carnival or other entertainment articles) → 9505.90.60.00.
Clodronic acid disodium salt is a bisphosphonate (phosphonic acid derivative), not a binder, amide, or hormone, so none of the listed headings (3824, 2924, 2937) apply.

The adult theatrical costume falls under heading 9505 (festive, carnival or other entertainment articles) and is not a magic trick or Christmas article, so it is classified in subheading 9505.90 Other, specifically 9505.90.60.00 as per prior rulings (e.g., N337371).
The product is natural basalt stone, a natural stone (crushed) classified under heading 6801.10.00, not under headings 6810 or 7103.

Etripamil is a bulk pharmaceutical active ingredient, which under HTS Chapter 29 falls under heading 2934 (heterocyclic compounds) and subheading 2934.99.30 for drugs, consistent with prior rulings for similar bulk drug substances.
The ear cup assemblies are parts of a headphone/earphone (aviation headset) and, per past rulings, are classified under heading 8518.90 (parts) → subheading 8518.90.81.00.

The item is a stainless‑steel screw with a shank diameter under 6 mm, so under heading 7318.15 (other screws), subheading 7318.15.60 (diameter <6 mm) and further 7318.15.60.70 for stainless‑steel articles.

The product is an insulated electric conductor (data cable) without connectors, not coaxial or optical fiber, and rated ≤1,000 V, so it falls under heading 8544 → subheading 8544.49 → 8544.49.90.00 (Other).
The product is an ambient (non‑frozen) sweet baked bread with fruit, so under Chapter 19 it falls under 1905.90.10 and, because it is not frozen, the appropriate subheading is 1905.90.10.50.
The product contains nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, so under GRI 1 and Chapter 31 heading 3105 it is classified as a mineral fertilizer containing the three elements (3105.20.00.00).
The arbor is a decorative metal structure, classifiable as a 'statuette or other ornament of base metal' under heading 8306, subheading 8306.29.00.00 (Other).

The product is a topical medicament (gel) containing diclofenac sodium, a dermatological NSAID, thus classified under heading 3004 and subheading 3004.90.92.51 for dermatological agents and local anesthetics.

The product is a finished aluminum shower enclosure, which is a sanitary ware item, and heading 7615 covers "sanitary ware and parts thereof" of aluminum, making 7615.20.00.00 the most specific applicable classification.

The kit is principally a collection of plastic beads, charms and spangles not strung, which under heading 3926.90 falls under subheading 35 for beads, bugles and spangles, not elsewhere specified (see N334271 ruling).

The brief is made of nonwoven polypropylene (not knitted or crocheted), so Chapter 61 headings 6108 do not apply; the correct heading would be under Chapter 63 (e.g., 6304.92.00 for women's underpants of other textile materials).
The kit is a craft supply of plastic beads (not strung) and thread, classifiable under 3926.90.35.00 per the heading for beads not strung, as in past ruling N334271.

The product is a frozen prepared meal containing shrimp (crustacean) and clams, so under GRI it falls under Chapter 16 and the heading for prepared meals containing fish/crustacean meat (1605.40.05.00).
The Lada Niva is principally a passenger vehicle, so it falls under heading 8703; lacking a matching engine‑capacity subheading among the options, it is classified under 8703.90 “Other”.

A knit bralette is not a 'top' but a support garment, so under Chapter 61 it falls under heading 6114 (Other garments, knitted or crocheted) → subheading 6114.30 (man‑made fibers) → 6114.30.30 (Other) → 6114.30.30.70 for women's or girls' other garments.

The racks are free‑standing storage units made of steel, not mountings or brackets for furniture, thus they fall under heading 7326 (Other articles of iron or steel) as in past rulings for similar steel storage racks.
The GripVR is a handheld RF remote control for VR headsets, not a video game console, thus it falls under 8526.92.50.00 – other radio remote control apparatus.
The unit is a gear pump (rotary positive‑displacement pump) for liquids, fitting heading 8413.60.00 and subheading .30 for gear‑type pumps.

The item is a decorative article whose essential character is preserved natural (dried) cut flowers, classifiable under heading 0603 (cut flowers, dried/impregnated), and similar framed dried‑flower decorations have been ruled to 0603.90.00.00.
The items are Halloween wall/door decorations, not magic tricks or practical jokes, thus fall under 9505.90 Other, specifically 9505.90.60.00 per heading 9505 and past rulings.
The MOSFETs are transistors (8541.29) and their operating frequency is 1 MHz, which falls under the subheading 8541.29.00.55 “with an operating frequency less than 30 MHz".

The kit’s essential character is the plastic hair clips, which are hair accessories of plastic, classifiable under heading 9615.11; past rulings for similar decorative plastic hair clips used 9615.11.50.
The bag’s outer surface is sheeting of plastics and it is a tote/handbag‑type container, classifiable under 4202.22.15.00 (handbags with outer surface of sheeting of plastics).
The item is an upholstered seat with a wooden frame intended for household use, so it falls under 9401.61.40.11 (Other seats, with wooden frames, other household).

The case’s outer surface is made of man‑made textile materials, fitting 4202.12 (outer surface of textile materials) and further classified under 4202.12.81.81.70 for man‑made fibers – i.e., 4202.12.81.70.
The ABS plastic wall‑mount bracket is an 'other article of plastics' not elsewhere specified, matching 3926.90.99.89 as applied to similar plastic brackets (e.g., N351764).

The frozen wheat‑flour wrappers with filling meet the definition of “stuffed pasta” under heading 1902.20, as affirmed by prior rulings (e.g., N336110, N343875) classifying similar frozen dumplings as 1902.20.00.40.
The bag’s outer surface is sheeting of plastics and, because it is a wheeled tote used for travel, it falls under heading 4202.92 (travel, sports and similar bags) → subheading 4202.92.45.00 “Other.”

The board is a printed circuit assembly used for network communication/control in an industrial device, matching the description of boards equipped with apparatus for electric control under heading 8537, as in prior rulings classifying similar PCBA control boards to 8537.10.91.70.

The device is an electronic apparatus with a specific function (digital signal processing of audio) not elsewhere specified, thus falls under heading 8543.70 (Other machines and apparatus) per the chapter 85 notes.

The unit is a gas‑fired condensing hydronic boiler for commercial/industrial central heating, which falls under heading 8403 – Central heating boilers, specifically subheading 8403.10.00.00 (Boilers).
The item is a textile wall hanging (cotton braid) used as a furnishing article, thus falls under heading 6304 and subheading 6304.92 for non‑knitted cotton articles.
The product is a chemical preparation for bathing (a bath bomb) and should be classified under Chapter 38 (e.g., 3824.90.00), not under the listed chemical ingredient (2836) or metal headings.
The sedan is a motor car for persons with a 1,994 cc spark‑ignition engine, placing it in heading 8703, subheading 8703.22.01; being used makes the correct full code 8703.22.01.90.

The steel cylinder is a pressurized vessel intended for a refrigerant (a compressed/liquefied gas), which is excluded from heading 7310 (tanks for any material other than compressed or liquefied gas) and is not helium, so neither candidate A, B, nor C is appropriate.
The item is a steel fastener with a threaded end and an eye loop, fitting the definition of a screw hook/eye bolt under heading 7318, subheading 7318.19.00.00 (Other threaded articles).
The garments are knitted pullovers of polyester (a man‑made fiber), so they fall under heading 6110.30; similar sleeveless polyester pullovers have been classified under subheading 6110.30.30.53.
The knee protectors are primarily plastic foam articles worn for protection, not medical devices, and thus fall under heading 39 (plastics) → 3926.90.99.89 "Other".

The polyurethane knee board is a pad for kneeling support used in physical activity and is not elsewhere specified, thus classifies under 9506.91.00.30 – other articles and equipment for general physical exercise, gymnastics or athletics.
The wood shavings are sold as animal bedding, a non‑textile article of bedding, which under GRI falls under heading 9404 and subheading 9404.90 (Other articles of bedding).

The item is a cold‑bent, uncoated steel wire, which falls under heading 7217 (wire of iron or non‑alloy steel) and specifically 7217.10.90.00 (other wire), per the heading wording and because it is not a seat or seat part per se.

The item is a non‑toy Halloween decorative figure, which under the chapter‑95 heading 9505 (festive, carnival or other entertainment articles) is classified in subheading 9505.90.60.00 as other festive decorations, consistent with prior CBP rulings for similar Halloween décor.
